  "storedItems": 67,
  "maxAllowed": 40
}

storedItemsis the current number of items in the DB for that user.

Banners:
👀 VIEWING IN FAVORITES / LIST PAGE

Here, terms = numFilteredResults from the API 

The API returns the following JSON :
"freemiumLimit":{
"limitReached":false,
"storedFavsNo":0,
"numberOfFavsAllowed":40
}
}

Considering these, the following specs apply

## CASE #1 : If limitReached= true
Display Premium Banner Limit reached

#### If numFilteredResults > numberOfFavsAllowed
Add numberOfFavsAllowed in orange before the numFilteredResults total (ex. 40/67) 

## CASE #2 : Else (=limitReached= false)

#### if numFilteredResults < 10
For anonymous : Register banner
For registered : nothing

#### if numFilteredResults > 10 
Premium banner V1 on top and at the bottom

Premium not registered → Register banner on top, no matter the number of terms.




⭐️ SAVING EVENT
→ The numbers in red refer to the number of favorites with originalListID=null
3rd and 6th save → Register popup for anonymous
≥ 10 terms → Premium nagging
≥ 40 terms → Premium wall on every click on star but make the star yellow
> 200 terms → Premium wall on every click on star but don’t save (the star remains empty)
